course.title: Modern Iron and Steel Making
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A blast furnace pig iron of composition of Fe-93.0%, C-3.6%, Si-2%, Mn-0.5%, P-0.9%. The flux amounts to one-fourth the weight of the ore. Consumption of coke is 780 kg/ton of pig iron. The gases carry 2 parts CO to 1 part CO2. Assume that 99.0% of the iron is reduced and 1% iron is slagged. Calculate
(i) the weight of the ore required to produce one ton (1000kg) pig iron.
(ii) the weight of slag made from one ton pig iron and its composition
(iii) volume and composition of blast furnace gas.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
